trials.claim: Save hours every day with tips and tricks
trials.claimQuote: Save hours every day with tips and tricks
trials.reasoning: Other buyers describe trivial topics like column width and emojis and say the course offered nothing beyond a quick Google search, which materially undercuts saving hours every day despite one buyer saving time.

exhibits.quote: They cover very specific uses, like "4 Ways to Change Column Width", or "How do I Insert Emojis into Google Sheets?"
exhibits.argument: Trivial topics like column width and emojis undermine the claim of saving hours every day.

exhibits.quote: Being a somewhat power user didn't offered me much I must say that a google search wouldn't solve immediately.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports learning nothing beyond a quick Google search, contradicting daily hours saved.

exhibits.quote: Now, I've saved so much time with all the different techniques and everyone at my work thinks I'm some sort of advanced guru.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms they saved so much time using the techniques taught.

trials.claim: Create a storefront with buyable products with Google Sheets Templates
trials.claimQuote: Create a storefront with buyable products with our Google Sheets Templates
trials.reasoning: The review mentions selling Sheets solutions as software apps, but does not mention creating a storefront with buyable products using the templates, so the specific claim is not directly supported.

exhibits.quote: He even shows you how to make money selling your solutions by turning Google Sheets into functional software apps.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the course teaches how to sell Google Sheets solutions for money.

trials.claim: Learn how to create business models for any type of business
trials.claimQuote: Learn how to create business models for any type of business
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly confirms the course covers versatile business models, along with database creation and formula combinations, with no exhibit undercutting it.

exhibits.quote: The course covers versatile business models, database creation, and formula combinations.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the course covers versatile business models.

trials.claim: Make everyone think you're a Google Sheets guru
trials.claimQuote: Make everyone think you're some sort of Google Sheets guru
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly confirms coworkers now think they are an advanced guru; the prosecution exhibits criticize the instructor, not whether buyers achieve that perception.

exhibits.quote: Not really an expert. I asked him how to convert numbers into words, but he was unable to do it.
exhibits.argument: Founder failing a basic Sheets task contradicts the guru image promise.

exhibits.quote: When I spend more time searching the net for this topic, I am able to do that myself
exhibits.argument: Buyer outperforming the instructor with web search undermines guru-level expertise.

exhibits.quote: everyone at my work thinks I'm some sort of advanced guru.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms coworkers now think they are an advanced guru.

trials.claim: Become faster, more productive, and more engaged in your work
trials.claimQuote: Become faster, more productive, and more engaged in your work
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the course offered little beyond an immediate Google search, directly conflicting with becoming faster and more productive, despite another buyer praising tool efficiency.

exhibits.quote: Being a somewhat power user didn't offered me much I must say that a google search wouldn't solve immediately.
exhibits.argument: No gain beyond Google search contradicts becoming faster and more productive.

exhibits.quote: I regret buying it - Wouldn't have purchased if I realized there was no refunds.
exhibits.argument: Buyer regret signals lack of productivity and engagement value from the work.

exhibits.quote: Access to tools like Better Letters and OnlySheets will boost your efficiency.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tools boost efficiency, supporting productivity claims.
